verdict.rationale: stagewise has a cloud account service and an enterprise tier, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows users bringing their own provider API keys (BYOK) or using a stagewise Account. Nothing shows stagewise issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent, and SSO/SCIM and BYOK are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
